The project

FOUNDER OF ATHLÈTES HYBRIDES

I coach 250+ athletes across hybrid strength/endurance training, Hyrox, trail running, triathlon, and tactical preparation, with 50%+ of my current athletes serving in the French military or Gendarmerie.

Before founding Athlètes Hybrides, I opened and led a new Abercrombie & Fitch flagship from the ground up: recruitment, merchandising, visual buildout and launch, growing it to the #1 ranking worldwide on guest loyalty enrollment within months, and hiring 70+ team members over 3 years.

I'm relocating to Los Angeles to bring that same operational discipline: performance coaching, team leadership and business execution, to private clients, premium fitness brands, and wellness-focused teams.

Background: NASM-certified personal trainer and nutrition coach (NASM-PES in progress), commercial fitness/lifestyle model. Bilingual French/English.

How I work

PEOPLE FIRST, SYSTEMS SECOND

Performance is the outcome. People, systems, and leadership are how I get there.

01: PROGRAMMING

Built Around the Person

Every plan starts with an assessment: current level, goals, constraints, training history, strengths and recovery capacity. From there: programming, progression, monitoring, adaptation. Built to handle hybrid demands: strength, endurance, hypertrophy, sport-specific performance, inside the constraints of a real schedule.

02: MONITORING

Coaching, Not Just Programming

Programming is half the job. I track progress, adjust for feedback and fatigue, and stay directly reachable between sessions, weekly calls and debriefs included. I don't just write programs. I coach the person executing them.

03: LEADERSHIP

Development & Standards

Before Athlètes Hybrides, I hired and developed retail teams, recruiting for mindset first, then building skills, standards, and performance. The context changed from retail to coaching, but the principle didn't: identify potential, develop the individual, set the standard, build the environment required to perform.
